lessons.claim: [W] states the validity range of Stokes-Einstein D = kT/(6 pi r mu) explicitly -- when 'a colloidal particle or a large spherical molecule' diffuses 'through a solvent that behaves as a continuum with respect to the diffusing species'. Our systems (1.47~5 um PMMA in water) are in the middle of that condition. A small-molecule solute uses Wilke-Chang D*mu/T = 7.4e-8 (Phi_B M_B)^0.5 / V_A^0.6 (cgs, cP) instead, and an electrolyte ion is neither, so appendix J's table has to be consulted
